ITAZip Privacy Policy

Effective date: October 4, 2026. Publisher: HYUNSUNG LEE. This policy covers the ITAZip app for macOS.

Files stay on your Mac

ITAZip processes archives and their contents on your Mac. It does not upload your files, archive names, passwords, or file contents to the publisher. The app does not include advertising, analytics, tracking, or an account service. ITAZip is free and has no in-app purchases.

Information stored on your device

ITAZip stores preferences, recent archive history, and access bookmarks on your Mac. An access bookmark lets macOS restore access to a file or folder you selected. The app creates temporary files for archive operations and saves extracted or created files to the destination you select. Temporary files can remain after an interrupted operation.

If you choose to save a password, ITAZip stores it in your Mac Keychain. Saved vault entries use device-only Keychain storage. The app does not send them to the publisher. You can remove saved entries in the password manager and clear recent archive history in settings. Removing the app does not necessarily remove Keychain entries or files saved outside the app.

Services you choose

Files in an iCloud Drive folder or another synced folder can be transferred by that provider. Opening a file in another app can expose it to that app's services. These transfers follow your settings and the other provider's policies. They are not uploads to an ITAZip server.

Support and Apple diagnostics

If you contact support, the publisher receives the email address, message, and attachments you choose to send. This information is used to respond and resolve the issue. Do not send archive passwords or sensitive files. Support correspondence is kept only as needed to handle the request and related obligations. You can request deletion through the contact below, subject to legal requirements.

Apple can process purchase records, crash reports, diagnostics, or TestFlight feedback under Apple's terms and your sharing settings. The publisher can receive reports made available by Apple. ITAZip does not include a separate analytics or crash-reporting SDK.

Contact and changes

For support, privacy questions, or deletion of support correspondence, email the public contact. The publisher is HYUNSUNG LEE. Policy changes will appear here with a revised effective date.
